title: fix: resolvido erro ao passar conteúdo extraído do youtube para o agente de buscas
author: antonioanerao
intent: Fixes a bug where the full youtube_agent result dump was extracted from media_contexts via a fragile next() scan and passed verbatim to the search query builder. Introduces a new youtube_research_context state field populated with a compact, truncated, bullet-formatted context (max 3 segments × 400 chars) produced by a new format_research_context() formatter. The search query builder now reads from this dedicated field rather than scanning the unstructured media_contexts list.
